regime_context: The TSX thematic detector shows Big Banks as the dominant, eligible theme with full breadth and high durability but crowded. Base Metals is the rotation challenger, though its breadth is zero. The absolute-trend gate—the only validated edge for drawdown control—passes for 11 of 16 themes, and the overall rotation is broad (0.69 eligible) but not one-narrative driven. Momentum ranks serve as a focus lens, not a return forecast.
emerging_watch: Retire this watch if by 2026-08-28, Base Metals & Copper breadth remains at 0 or its durability stays below 0.5, and Big Banks durability remains above 0.6—otherwise monitor for a possible leadership handoff.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks holds the leading momentum score with full breadth (1.0), high durability (0.69), and passes the absolute-trend gate. The crowded flag warrants sizing caution, not fading. We lean overweight on the premise that the theme's trend and eligibility persist.
theses.dissent: Strong inflows and crowding raise the risk of momentum exhaustion or a mean-reversion if rate expectations shift.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 3% over any rolling 10-day period within the next 21 trading days.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals ranks second, is eligible, and is identified as the rotation challenger. It is not crowded and has a moderate durability reading, suggesting potential to build on its momentum, though the zero breadth indicates narrow leadership.
theses.dissent: Zero breadth means the move is concentrated in very few names; a commodity pullback could reverse the theme rapidly.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO underperforms ZEB.TO by more than 5% over the next 30 trading days.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology fails the absolute-trend gate (eligible=false) despite a high durability reading, indicating the trend structure is no longer intact. Combined with a negative momentum score (-0.60), this warrants avoiding long exposure to the theme.
theses.dissent: A sharp macro reversal could catalyze a mean-reversion rally in tech, and the high durability suggests the prior trend had strength.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 5% over the next 42 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
